+# AI Actions
+
+When a user selects an image object on the canvas, the right-side panel switches from the generation settings to an "Actions" view. These actions invoke AI backends (ComfyUI workflows, Gemini) to modify or enhance the selected image.
+
+## Action Types
+
+The active action is tracked by a Zustand store:
+
+```typescript
+// store/active-actions-store.ts
+export type ActionType =
+  | 'main' // Default: show action buttons grid
+  | 'regenerate' // Re-generate with full generation settings
+  | 'enhance' // Enhance face (placeholder)
+  | 'change-bg' // Change background (placeholder)
+  | 'rmbg' // Remove background
+  | 'upscale' // Upscale image (placeholder)
+  | 'retouch' // Inpaint/retouch with mask painting
+  | 'expand' // Outpaint -- extend image beyond borders
+  | 'expression' // Change facial expression
+  | 'ai-edit' // AI-assisted edit
+  | 'remove-object'; // Remove object from image via inpainting
+```
+
+## Action Components
+
+Each action has a dedicated component in `components/canvas/actions-info/`:
+
+| Action            | Component      | File                                           | Status                                              |
+| ----------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
+| Regenerate        | `Regenerate`   | `actions-info/regenerate.tsx`                  | Active -- renders full `GenerateImage` form         |
+| Enhance Face      | `Enhance`      | `actions-info/enhance.tsx`                     | Placeholder (UI coming soon)                        |
+| Change Background | `ChangeBg`     | `actions-info/change-bg.tsx`                   | Placeholder (UI coming soon)                        |
+| Upscale           | `Upscale`      | `actions-info/upscale.tsx`                     | Placeholder (UI coming soon)                        |
+| Retouch           | `Retouch`      | `actions-info/retouch.tsx`                     | Active -- renders `RetouchImage` with mask painting |
+| Expand            | `Expand`       | `actions-info/expand.tsx`                      | Active -- outpainting with directional padding      |
+| Expression        | `Expression`   | `actions-info/expression.tsx`                  | Active -- facial expression changer                 |
+| Remove Object     | `RemoveObject` | `actions-info/remove-object.tsx`               | Active -- renders `RemoveImageObject`               |
+| Action Header     | `ActionHeader` | `actions-info/action-header.tsx`               | Shared back-button header for all actions           |
+| SVG Handler       | --             | `actions-info/action-handlers/svg-handler.tsx` | Helper for SVG mask processing                      |
+
+## Action Flows
+
+### Regenerate
+
+Re-generates an image using the full generation form. Reuses the same `GenerateImage` component from the generate-info panel.
+
+| Layer | File                               | Function/Component        |
+| ----- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
+| UI    | `actions-info/regenerate.tsx`      | `Regenerate`              |
+| UI    | `generate-info/generate-image.tsx` | `GenerateImage`           |
+| Hook  | `hooks/use-image-generation.ts`    | `useImageGeneration`      |
+| Store | `store/canvas-store.ts`            | `updateTempCanvasObjects` |
+
+### Expand (Outpaint)
+
+Extends the image beyond its current borders using ComfyUI's outpainting workflow. The user sets directional padding (left, top, right, bottom) and provides a prompt.
+
+| Layer   | File                                       | Function/Component                            |
+| ------- | ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
+| UI      | `actions-info/expand.tsx`                  | `Expand`                                      |
+| UI      | `actions-info/interactive-expand-form.tsx` | `InteractiveExpandForm`                       |
+| Hook    | `hooks/use-canvas-generation-handler.ts`   | `useCanvasGenerationHandler.generateOnCanvas` |
+| Hook    | `hooks/use-canvas-prompt-translator.ts`    | Auto-translate user prompt                    |
+| API     | `lib/comfyui.ts`                           | `startOutpaintImageGeneration`                |
+| Polling | `components/canvas/util.ts`                | `pollForGeneration`                           |
+
+### Retouch (Inpaint)
+
+The user paints a mask over the region to modify, enters a prompt, and the system inpaints the masked area. Activating retouch switches the tool to `'paint'`.
+
+| Layer  | File                                              | Function/Component         |
+| ------ | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
+| UI     | `actions-info/retouch.tsx`                        | `Retouch`                  |
+| UI     | `generate-info/retouch-image.tsx`                 | `RetouchImage`             |
+| Hook   | `hooks/use-canvas-generation-handler.ts`          | `generateOnCanvas`         |
+| Store  | `store/tool-state.ts`                             | `setSelectedTool('paint')` |
+| Helper | `generate-info/helpers/retouch-image-helpers.tsx` | Mask data conversion       |
+
+### Expression (Facial Expression)
+
+Changes the facial expression of a detected face in the image. Uses bounding box detection to identify faces, then applies a selected expression via LoRA-based generation.
+
+| Layer  | File                                      | Function/Component                   |
+| ------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
+| UI     | `actions-info/expression.tsx`             | `Expression`                         |
+| UI     | `generate-info/facial-expression.tsx`     | `FacialExpression`                   |
+| Hook   | `hooks/useCanvasFaceExpressionsEvents.ts` | Bounding box management              |
+| Hook   | `hooks/use-canvas-generation-handler.ts`  | `generateOnCanvas`                   |
+| API    | `lib/comfyui.ts`                          | `startFaceExpressionImageGeneration` |
+| Config | `constants/canvas.ts`                     | `FacialExpressionConfig`             |
+
+### Remove Object
+
+Removes an object/region from the image by masking and inpainting. The user paints a mask over the area to remove.
+
+| Layer  | File                                                    | Function/Component  |
+| ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
+| UI     | `actions-info/remove-object.tsx`                        | `RemoveObject`      |
+| UI     | `generate-info/remove-image-object.tsx`                 | `RemoveImageObject` |
+| Helper | `generate-info/helpers/remove-object-image-helpers.tsx` | Mask processing     |
+| Hook   | `hooks/use-canvas-generation-handler.ts`                | `generateOnCanvas`  |
+
+## Panel-Specific Actions
+
+The `PanelActions` component (`actions-info/panel-actions.tsx`) and `PanelActionButtons` (`actions-info/panel-action-buttons.tsx`) are retained as placeholders. Download and publish actions previously per-panel have been moved to the toolbar dropdown components.
+
+## Multi-Selection Panel Actions
+
+When multiple panels are selected, action handles appear on each panel:
+
+| Component                          | File                                             | Description                            |
+| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
+| `PanelActionHandles`               | `konva/panel-action-handles.tsx`                 | Konva overlay for single panel actions |
+| `MultiSelectionPanelActionHandles` | `konva/multi-selection-panel-action-handles.tsx` | Handles for multi-selected panels      |
+
+## Generation Handler
+
+All AI actions that involve image generation share the `useCanvasGenerationHandler` hook:
+
+```typescript
+// hooks/use-canvas-generation-handler.ts
+const { generateOnCanvas, isGenerating } = useCanvasGenerationHandler();
+
+generateOnCanvas({
+  numberOfImages: 1,
+  objectId: targetObject?.id,
+  action: 'expand', // For tracking
+  imageObject: referenceImage, // Enables parallel generation overlay
+  generationRequest: async () => {
+    /* returns generation result */
+  },
+  onGenerationComplete: async ({ imageGenerationId, imageSrc }) => {
+    /* update canvas */
+  },
+  postGenerationCleanup: () => {}
+});
+```
+
+This hook handles:
+
+- Token balance checks
+- Generation polling
+- Loading indicator overlay on the image
+- Parallel generation slot management
+- Error handling and toast notifications
+
+## CanvasActionType Enum
+
+The `CanvasActionType` in `store/canvas-action-store.ts` defines the full set of tracked action types for history and statistics:
+
+```typescript
+export type CanvasActionType =
+  | 'select'
+  | 'move'
+  | 'resize'
+  | 'rotate'
+  | 'delete'
+  | 'copy'
+  | 'paste'
+  | 'cut'
+  | 'undo'
+  | 'redo'
+  | 'save'
+  | 'generate'
+  | 'regenerate'
